verdict.rationale: GPU-fallback diagnostics are a fair question for a local LLM runner, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of diagnostic output explaining why GPU acceleration failed or fell back to CPU. The `lms load --gpu` offload flag is an adjacent control, not diagnostics. Community reports point the other way: one user saw models fail to load with no error feedback, and another found no way to set CUDA acceleration before loading a model.
